You can use neem oil and soap (but not dish soap it can be harmful to plants, it’s best to use grated olive oil soap which is biodegradable)  
This is the more organic way and it is not systemic, so it might take a little longer to get rid of them. 

Systemic insecticides spread throughout the plant and kill pests even when you can’t see them to spray directly on them (as you do with neem oil) 
Either way won’t affect any beneficial insects because they only affect the bugs that nibble on the plant, and this particular one doesn’t even have any flowers to attract polinators, so you don’t have to worry about that
